page.overview:
Who is Jesse Linkam?

Nobleman Jesse Linkam is a character in Spice Planet, a short novel by Brian Herbert and Kevin J. Anderson, based on Frank Herbert's first outline for what would become Dune. He is the ruler of House Linkam on Catalan, father of Barri Linkam with his concubine Dorothy Mapes. His inept older brother, Hugo Linkam, the previous leader of the House, died in the bullring, and Jesse took up the position before his twentieth birthday.
